ask: can u set the pick order for the rooms, master goes to the first pick
sentence: Draws a random pick order for a shared house's rooms, then lets each person or pair in turn claim one open room with no switching afterward.
use_when: A group needs a fair, random order to choose bedrooms in a shared rental or vacation house
Everyone should take turns claiming one room each from a fixed list
Two people sharing a room should count as one pick
A group wants a visible record of who picked which room
dont_use_when: The group wants to vote on or rank preferences instead of picking in turns
The room list or the pairs sharing a room must be set up differently from the built-in list
Rooms need to be traded, swapped, or assigned by a person instead of picked
The order is for something other than rooms, such as chores or seating
